placedBecause: an artifact written by a run outside the test process

witness.recorder: lsof -nP -i -a -p <pid>, sampled every 350ms — the kernel's own view of a process's sockets, which Maestro does not participate in producing

armedBy: The arm is the variable itself: the same binary, the same argument, measured with and without MAESTRO_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1 — two sockets against one. A run that opened the same count either way would mean the variable does nothing, which is what MAESTRO_DISABLE_ANALYTICS turned out to be.
